title: Who Audits Whom, on What Substrate, with What Evidence? An Independence-Graded Audit Protocol for Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.18272v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems plan, invoke tools and act with limited supervision; they are now both the subject of audits and, increasingly, the auditor. Independence, the foundation of assurance,is still applied to them as a binary. We argue that it must be graded along three orthogonal axes: principal independence (who controls the auditor), substrate independence (an auditor sharing the auditee's foundation-model family, toolchain or guardrails fails with it) and evidence independence (whether evidence is attestable rather than self-reported). Each axis has precedent; the contribution is to grade all three on a single audit, aggregate them by the weakest link, and apply the same rubric when the auditor is itself an agent. translated_title: 谁审计谁、基于什么基座、用什么证据？面向智能体AI的独立性分级审计协议
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统能够在有限监督下进行规划、调用工具并执行行动；它们如今既是审计的对象，也日益成为审计者本身。独立性作为保证体系的基础，目前仍以二元方式应用于智能体AI。我们主张，独立性必须沿三个正交轴进行分级评估：主体独立性（谁控制审计者）、基座独立性（与被审计方共享基础模型系列、工具链或防护机制的审计者会随之一同失效）以及证据独立性（证据是可证实的还是自我报告的）。每个轴单独来看都有先例；本文的贡献在于在单次审计中对全部三个轴进行分级，按最薄弱环节原则进行聚合，并在审计者本身是智能体时应用相同的评级标准。我们通过移植可靠性工程中共因失效的β因子模型为该框架提供了形式化基础，提出了一个输出可供第三方验证的七步协议，以及结构性可检测性分析……
tldr: 本文提出将智能体AI审计中的“独立性”从二元概念升级为沿主体独立性、基座独立性和证据独立性三个正交轴分级的评估框架，借助可靠性工程的β因子共因失效模型给出形式化基础，并设计了按最薄弱环节聚合、输出可被第三方验证的七步审计协议，适用于审计者本身是AI智能体的场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes grading auditor independence for agentic AI along three orthogonal axes—principal, substrate, and evidence independence—rather than treating it as binary, formalizing the model via the beta-factor common-cause failure framework from reliability engineering and a seven-step protocol whose outputs are third-party verifiable and aggregated by the weakest link, even when the auditor is itself an AI agent.
